description: Ding, Yu and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The J81 dataset archive supports the named study of leading-edge protection application through energy and power decomposition. It supplies the measurements used to assess a physical blade-treatment intervention and its turbine-performance effects. The paired J82 code deposit implements the analysis and has a separate software role. Exact turbines, location, treatment dates, columns and sample intervals are not stated in this brief native description; they are not inferred from the paper title. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The native file inventory establishes deposited data, but values and linked file bodies were not read. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
